1. Close the gate by holding it about a foot from fully shut and releasing.

_Procedure reported by [t1691]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-make-your-rear-hatch-raise-higher-for-free.2627/>_

## Tips & gotchas

- The door will slam more easily due to increased force, so use caution when closing. [t1691]
- This method allows the hatch to swing nearly all the way up for taller clearance. [t1691]
